clue.text: Second joke presented by someone using words craftily?

definitions.text: presented by someone using words craftily?

parts.note: a pun is a joke built on wordplay

explanation.surface: A second-rate joke delivered by a smooth talker.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on a spin doctor: a story given a slant has been spun.
explanation.definitionFit: A story given a favourable slant by a spin doctor is said to have been spun.

clue.text: Only Conservative is beginning to make error

parts.note: sole means only, as in the sole survivor
taken as written

indicators.note: the beginning of the word make is its first letter, so only that letter is taken

explanation.surface: Only a Conservative would start to make a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: A solecism is a mistake in grammar or etiquette, so it is a kind of error.

clue.text: You want kitchen vessel? Then go where the food's kept

parts.note: a pan is a cooking vessel used in the kitchen
to have a go is to try

explanation.surface: Someone after a cooking pot is told to look in the larder.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantry is a small storeroom in a house for keeping food supplies.

clue.text: Finally throw end of loaf that is black in recycling container?

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word throw

parts.note: the heel is the crusty end piece of a loaf
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
taken as written

explanation.surface: Instructions to toss the stale end of a loaf into the bin.
explanation.walkthrough: A WHEELIE BIN is the large wheeled rubbish bin used in Britain; the question mark admits that not every such bin is for recycling.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheelie bin is a large outdoor household waste container on wheels, often used for recycling.

clue.text: Time to get a round in concert — find the bar

indicators.note: in places the round letter inside the word for a concert

parts.note: a prom is a promenade concert, as at the BBC Proms
the letter O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A trip to a concert where you buy a round of drinks at the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a round' suggests buying drinks; here the round is just the letter O. The Proms are a famous London summer concert season.
explanation.definitionFit: A taproom is a bar in a pub or inn where beer is served from the tap.

clue.text: Chord one gets in a type of jazz

indicators.note: the numeral gets in, so it is placed inside the jazz word

parts.note: trad is traditional jazz, the New Orleans style
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A musician finds a chord that fits a jazz style.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a triad is a chord of three notes, a root with its third and fifth.

clue.text: Joan takes Isle of Man road the wrong way

indicators.note: travelling a road the wrong way suggests its letters are disordered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A driver called Joan goes the wrong way along a Manx road.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man, between Britain and Ireland, is known for road racing, which makes the surface plausible.
explanation.definitionFit: Joan of Arc was nicknamed after the French city she relieved during the Hundred Years' War.

clue.text: The fellow protected by idiot remains

indicators.note: something protected by another sits inside it, so the fellow goes inside the idiot word

parts.note: an ass is a fool
he refers to a man, the fellow

explanation.surface: A man is shielded by a fool and something is left over.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashes are what remains after burning, especially a cremated body.

clue.text: Special corner, a bright spot

parts.note: an angle is a corner

explanation.surface: A special corner seems to be a sunny spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A spangle is a small glittering ornament, a tiny point of sparkle.

clue.text: One embraced by enthusiast at church — he may go there to get wed

definitions.text: he may go there to get wed

indicators.note: something embraced is held inside, so the numeral goes within the enthusiast word

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiast
I is the Roman numeral for one
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A keen churchgoer turns up at church to be married.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the whole closing phrase: an engaged man may go to church to marry.
explanation.definitionFit: An engaged man is the one who goes to the altar to marry his bride-to-be.

clue.text: Obstructive, with a yen to be different

indicators.note: the letters are made to be different, a call to rearrange them

explanation.surface: Someone eager for something different is getting in the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Something blocking a path is obstructive, a phrase meaning causing a hindrance.

clue.text: Warning politician, I'd moan terribly at the start

indicators.note: the moan anagram comes at the start, before the politician
done terribly, the letters are jumbled out of order

parts.note: a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: A Tory politician moans badly as a warning.
explanation.definitionFit: Admonitory means giving a warning or reprimand, an adjective like cautionary.

clue.text: Bands on the move in others' cars

indicators.note: letters on the move change places, signalling an anagram

explanation.surface: Musical groups travelling in other people's cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Orchestras are large instrumental groups, so they are bands of musicians.

clue.text: I proceed to grab a villain

parts.note: taken as written
to go is to proceed

explanation.surface: Someone moves forward to seize a villain.
explanation.walkthrough: The villain is Shakespeare's schemer in Othello.
explanation.definitionFit: Iago is the treacherous ensign who destroys Othello, one of literature's great villains.

clue.text: One club redesigned with format not conducive to relaxation

indicators.note: something redesigned is rearranged, so the letters are put in new order

explanation.surface: A club redesigns its layout and members can no longer relax.
explanation.definitionFit: Something uncomfortable causes unease, so it does not help one relax.

clue.text: Like a secret opinion that's stuffy?

definitions.meaning: an opinion kept to oneself has never been voiced in public
a stuffy room has not been ventilated with fresh air

explanation.definitionFit: Unaired means both never voiced publicly and never ventilated, fitting both halves.

clue.text: After sign of approval maiden perhaps becomes idle

indicators.note: the maiden piece comes after the approval piece

parts.note: a tick is a mark showing approval
a maiden over is a cricket over with no runs scored, so a maiden is an example of an over

explanation.surface: After a tick of approval, a young woman becomes lazy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maiden' looks like a young woman; in cricket a maiden is an over with no runs.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine that ticks over runs slowly while disengaged, which is to idle.

clue.text: Confront female expert

parts.note: an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: Standing up to a woman who is an expert.
explanation.definitionFit: To face something is to confront or meet it head on.

clue.text: New car with Cellnet that can deal with phone messages

definitions.text: that can deal with phone messages

indicators.note: a new version of the letters is made by rearranging them

explanation.surface: An advert for a new car with a Cellnet mobile phone fitted.
explanation.walkthrough: Cellnet was a British mobile phone network of the 1980s and 1990s.
explanation.definitionFit: A call centre is an office staffed to handle large volumes of telephone calls.

clue.text: Former President in vehicle with Her Majesty

parts.note: a cart is a simple vehicle
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: An ex-president rides in a car alongside the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Jimmy Carter was the 39th President of the United States.

clue.text: Australian mammals need time to find shelter

parts.note: roos is short for kangaroos

explanation.surface: Kangaroos taking time to find a place to rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A roost is a resting place for birds, a perch giving shelter.

clue.text: Canons in cold form of worship look retrogressive

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
a rite is a religious ceremony

indicators.note: moving backwards, so the look word is read in reverse

parts.note: an air is a manner or look, as in an air of confidence

explanation.surface: A cold style of worship seems backward-looking to the clergy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Canons' suggests clergy, fitting the church surface, but it means standards.
explanation.definitionFit: Canons are principles or standards by which things are judged.

clue.text: Like many a favourite relation, strange at first

indicators.note: the strange word comes first, before the relation

parts.note: odd means strange
a son is a family relation

explanation.surface: A favourite son who seemed strange at first.
explanation.definitionFit: In betting a favourite usually has odds-on prices, more likely to win than lose.

clue.text: Accommodation evoking snide comments

definitions.meaning: lodgings or rented rooms, especially for students
jibes or sly remarks aimed at someone

explanation.definitionFit: Digs is slang for lodgings and also for barbed remarks.

clue.text: Male on water? Yes, yes!

parts.note: a male bird swimming on a pond, and also a famous English seafarer, so the double affirmation confirms both readings

explanation.walkthrough: Both the male duck and Sir Francis Drake, the Elizabethan sea captain, are males on water; the repeated yes affirms each.
explanation.definitionFit: The male of a duck is so called, and an Elizabethan navigator shared the name.

clue.text: Cunning vision that accommodates the French

indicators.note: to accommodate is to hold within, so the vision word houses the French article

parts.note: sight is vision
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A crafty view that makes room for French people.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleight means dexterity or cunning, as in sleight of hand.
